|     |         |

| ❌  | The PR description still says "Fixes part of: #16094" and still has it before the testing section. |
| ❌  | The screenshots look unchanged: the same wide before/after images are still there, with no cropped, precise ones. |

###### Next step

Keep "not ready" and ask the author to make the commit and description changes and replace the screenshots.

###### Reply

```quote
Thanks @Amormio25! The commit messages and PR description don't look updated yet. Could you remove "Fixes part of" from the commits, add "Fixes: #16094" to the last commit, and move it after the description? Please also replace the screenshots with [precise before/after ones](https://zulip.readthedocs.io/en/latest/contributing/presenting-visual-changes.html#what-are-precise-before-after-screenshots).
```
